title: Donor-held-out blinded successor evaluation on the never-seen Kang 2018 GSE96583 cohort

amendment_history.change: initial preregistration draft failed the panel audit at scoring time (TRBC1/TRBC2 absent from the GSE96583 capture panel); the design was amended to freeze panel-intersected modules before any scoring. No labels were accessed and no threshold was derived at amendment time.

predecessor.reason_for_successor: BN-ANN-IV-003 met all endpoints but was explicitly NOT_BLINDED_TO_LABEL_DISTRIBUTION on a single-pool external reference. This successor derives the threshold only on development donors of a never-seen donor-aware cohort and locks before any holdout label access; BN-ANN-IV-003 remains unchanged.

access_disclosure.consequence: Same-implementer blinding cannot be absolute; a successful result is capped below independent blinded external validation and below CERTIFIED, which additionally requires cross-host execution and an external reviewer.

claim_target: With the BN-ANN-IV-001 candidate rule unchanged except for the capture-panel intersection of its marker modules (frozen before any scoring), the RNA margin gate with a threshold derived only on development donors selectively enriches agreement with the published external reference labels on held-out donors never used for threshold derivation.
claim_exclusions: certification promotion without cross-host execution and external review

external_holdout.reference_labels: geo_cell_type (published Kang et al. 2017 GEO/Seurat assignments, corroborated by the committed GSE96583_batch2.total.tsne.df.tsv.gz supplementary)
external_holdout.source_citation: Kang et al. 2017, Nat Biotechnol 35:404-406, GSE96583 (GPL24676)

donor_split.rule: sorted donor identifiers, first half development, second half holdout

rna_candidate_rule.matrix_source: adata.X (verified finite non-negative integer raw counts)
rna_candidate_rule.normalization: per-cell raw counts per 10000 followed by log1p
rna_candidate_rule.label: highest mean expression across the panel-intersected lineage modules
rna_candidate_rule.minimum_module_size_rule: every intersected module retains >= 2 markers; otherwise the study design must change
rna_candidate_rule.confidence_score: top module mean minus runner-up module mean
rna_candidate_rule.mapping_notes: Dendritic cells map to the coarse MONOCYTE family (shared myeloid module markers); this is the conservative direction. Megakaryocytes have no preregistered module and are excluded and enumerated.

threshold_selection_protocol.eligibility: development-donor pooled accepted-precision Wilson lower 95 >= 0.9 AND development coverage in [0.1, 0.8]
threshold_selection_protocol.selection: eligible threshold with maximum development coverage; ties broken toward the smaller margin

locked_candidate_threshold.selected_on: development donors only (101, 107, 1015, 1016) of GSE96583; holdout labels not consulted

governance.independent_ground_truth_reason: Published GEO/Seurat assignments are external reference labels, not an independent experimental truth standard; same-implementer blinding is partial by construction.
